harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 8 requests of probe.py 34 (tenth build), all kind ord, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions: THE DATA WAITING WORD AND THE OWN-PREDICATE READER as cubit's own builds hold them. (A) the set N,i,gN,gN (an unguarded `LDG.E.CONSTANT`, a `SHFL.IDX`, two guarded `LDG.E.CONSTANT` under ONE predicate, every member on the same write barrier with the yield flag), the third write of the predicate from the lane one cycle in front of the waiting word, the reader into the set's own predicate: s_nigg_o_cc_l is the reference (`ISETP.GE.AND P0` of the shuffle's register on the one wait); s_nigg_o_cc_ly = "pown": "text" - the reader is `ISETP.GE.AND P0, PT, R<i>, R72, PT` with A WAIT BIT OF ITS OWN, the yield flag and a register comparand (R72 = 0 since the top of the iteration); the members 1 and 4 cycles apart, no word in front. (B) the set `SYNCS.CCTL.IVALL`, `SHFL.IDX`, `LDCU.64` whose one wait stands on a data word that reads no member, in front of the first reader word: w_yil_f is the reference; w_yil_fy = "wflag": true - THE DATA WAITING WORD CARRIES THE YIELD FLAG; w_yil_f2 = "wover": "shfl2" - a shuffle outside the set pends in front of it on READ barrier 2 and write barrier 3, the data waiting word `MOV R73, R5` overwrites the shuffles' source register and waits the set's barrier AND barrier 2; w_yil_ty2 = both, with "wplace": "text" and "rgap": 12 - the data word one cycle behind a flagged word without a barrier and 4 cycles behind the load, its first reader 12 cycles behind it with a wait bit of its own, and the event pair `WARPSYNC.ALL` + `BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING 0x0` waiting the same barrier again 101 cycles behind the data word; w_yil_dy2 = the same data word with the event pair 7 cycles behind it; w_yil_ty2_n is the control - the words of w_yil_ty2 in the same places, no barrier and no wait (1, 2 and 4 cycles: it must not be right). The members 1 and 4 cycles apart; fronts of (B): no word in front, and fifteen `STS.128` at stall 4 in front; the kernels of w_yil_ty2, w_yil_dy2 and w_yil_ty2_n hold a named-barrier word

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
conditions.card_state: a Server Edition card (this model takes no clock offset); the probe alone, no power limit

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
